description: Send a planned trade, options position or portfolio and get a written decision memo: proceed, proceed with changes, or do not proceed, with the risks, the exact changes to make, the rules that apply and a dated note for your audit file. Runs pre_trade_check, position_size, tax_lot_plan, options_risk_check and portfolio_review on whichever sections you send, then Claude writes the memo; it never overrides a failed check. Paid only (credits or x402); free and trial calls don't cover it. Price: $0.1, paid only.
